title: Iminodiacetic acid stabilized 3d-4f clusters: Synthesis, structure, and magnetism
claim: Carbonate commonly binds lanthanides through three oxygen donors to give pentagonal {Ln5} and hexagonal {Ln6} units, while halides can template high-nuclearity cores without directly coordinating the metals.
explanation: Directly incorporated anions listed include carbonate, nitrate, sulfate, sulfite, silicate, and molybdate. Carbonate is linked to classic dodecahedral La-Ni clusters and those Ln5/Ln6 motifs. Halides in Gd158Co38@(Cl/Br)12 are described as electrostatic templates that organize metal ions without metal coordination.
caveats: Not every listed anion produces the same Ln5 or Ln6 motif; those geometries are specifically attributed to carbonate.
